title: ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE SPECIAL ACT ON THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE DALGUBIT RAILROAD
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE SPECIAL ACT ON THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE DALGUBIT RAILROAD

Article 1 (Purpose)
This Rule prescribes matters delegated by the Special Act on the Construction of the Dalgubit Railroad and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for their enforcement.

Article 2 (Application for designation as project implementer)
(1) The application for designation as an implementer of the Dalgubit Railroad construction project under Article 3(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Construction of the Dalgubit Railroad (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be as set out in attached Form 1.
(2) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport designates a project implementer under Article 9(2) of the Special Act on the Construction of the Dalgubit Railroad (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the Minister shall issue the applicant a certificate of designation as project implementer in attached Form 2.

Article 3 (Application for approval of an implementation plan)
(1) A person implementing the Dalgubit Railroad construction project under Article 9 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “project implementer”) who intends to obtain approval of a Dalgubit Railroad construction project implementation plan (hereinafter referred to as an “implementation plan”) under Article 10(1) of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport the application for approval or approval of an amendment in attached Form 3, accompanied by an implementation plan containing the matters in each subparagraph of Article 4 of the Decree.
(2) A project implementer who intends to obtain approval of an amendment to an implementation plan under Article 9(8) of the Act on Railroad Construction and Railroad Facilities Management, as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 10(2) of the Act, shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport the application in attached Form 3, accompanied by:
1. Details of, and reasons for, the amendment to the implementation plan;
2. Documents explaining the amendment to the implementation plan.

Article 4 (Identification of inspecting officials)
The identification of an inspecting public official under Article 15(2) of the Act shall be as set out in attached Form 4.

Article 5 (Standards for dispositions for violations)
The standards for dispositions under Article 16(1) of the Act shall be as set out in the Annex.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance of the Ministry No. 1376, August 14, 2024>
This Rule shall enter into force on August 14, 2024.

ANNEX — Standards for dispositions for violations (related to Article 5)
Enforcement Rule of the Special Act on the Construction of the Dalgubit Railroad [Annex]
Violation | Legal basis | Disposition
1. Obtaining permission or approval by fraud or other improper means | Article 16(1)1 of the Act | Revocation of permission or approval.
2. Violating the terms of approval of an implementation plan or approval of an amendment | Article 16(1)2 of the Act:
(a) Violating the terms of approval of an implementation plan or approval of an amendment | Suspension of construction for one month.
(b) Failing to obtain approval of an amendment to the implementation plan during the suspension period under item (a) | Order to reconstruct, alter, relocate or remove facilities or objects, or restore the original condition.
(c) Where there is a portion for which approval of an amendment to the implementation plan could not be obtained during the suspension period under item (a) | Order to reconstruct, alter, relocate or remove, or restore the original condition of, the portion of facilities or objects for which such approval could not be obtained.
3. Violating an order or disposition under the Act | Article 16(1)3 of the Act | Revocation of approval of an implementation plan under Article 10(1) of the Act or approval of an amendment under Article 10(2), or an order to suspend or alter construction, reconstruct, alter or relocate facilities or objects, or take other such measures.
4. A change of circumstances makes continuation of the Dalgubit Railroad construction project impossible | Article 16(1)4 of the Act | Revocation of approval.

Attachments:
1. When applying for approval of an implementation plan: an implementation plan containing the following matters. References to the “Act” below mean the Special Act on the Construction of the Dalgubit Railroad.
(a) A location map of the project implementation area;
(b) The location, lot number, land category, and area of land, articles, or rights to be expropriated or used (hereinafter referred to as "land, etc."); specifications of ownership and rights other than ownership; and the names and addresses of the owners and right holders thereof;
(c) Design documents, including plan views, cross-sectional views, and construction specifications;
(d) The project implementation period;
(e) A financing plan including the following matters and documents proving such plan (applicable only to the implementer of the Dalgubit Railroad construction project under Article 9(2) of the Act):
  (1) An annual investment plan;
  (2) An annual financing plan;
  (3) A plan for the recovery of investment costs, etc. by year;
(f) A plan for the purchase and compensation of land, etc. located within the project implementation area, and measures for the relocation of residents;
(g) Results of consultations with the heads of relevant administrative agencies regarding traffic impact assessments and environmental impact assessments;
(h) Results of a survey on the current status of national heritage;
(i) Measures to mitigate earthquake damage;
(j) If public facilities, etc. are to be installed to replace existing public facilities, etc. under Article 15(1) of the Act on Railroad Construction and Railroad Facilities Management, as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 5(2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "replacement public facilities, etc."), a plan for the relocation and demolition of the existing public facilities, etc. and a plan for the installation of the replacement public facilities, etc.;
(k) If there exist land and facilities that do not vest in the State under the proviso of Article 17(1) of the Act on Railroad Construction and Railroad Facilities Management, as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 5(2) of the Act, a plan for the disposal of such land and facilities;
(l) Where an implementation plan for the Dalgubit Railroad construction project under the former part of Article 10(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "implementation plan") is to be prepared by section or by facility under the latter part of that paragraph, the details thereof;
(m) Where there are matters subject to deliberation by the Railroad Industry Committee under Article 6 of the Framework Act on Railroad Industry Development under Article 9(2) of the Act on Railroad Construction and Railroad Facilities Management, as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 10(2) of the Act, the details of such matters for deliberation;
(n) Where there are deemed authorizations, permissions, etc. under the subparagraphs of Article 11(1) of the Act, the details thereof;
(o) Documents necessary for consultation with relevant authorizing or permitting administrative authorities under Article 24 of the Framework Act on Administration, as applied mutatis mutandis under Article 11(2) of the Act;
(p) Where the project is subject to deliberation by a technical advisory committee under Article 19(5) of the Enforcement Decree of the Construction Technology Promotion Act (limited to deliberation related to design), documents necessary for such deliberation.
2. When applying for approval of an amendment to an implementation plan:
(a) Details of, and reasons for, the amendment;
(b) Documents explaining the amendment.
Fee: None.
Processing procedure:
Applicant prepares the application. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (department responsible for the Dalgubit Railroad construction project) receives and examines it. Relevant central administrative agencies, Cities/Provinces and the Railroad Industry Committee carry out consultation or deliberation and return the results to the examination stage. The Ministry grants internal approval and notifies the applicant.
